name: Optimize SQLite index creation and retrieval in pi-session-manager

description: Baseline harness crash: project_path filter query returned zero hits because the synthetic dataset only put 'tokio async' into sessions whose cwd did not match /workspace/project-b. Need to rebalance fixture text so every query shape has stable hits before measuring performance.

Baseline benchmark succeeded at 602.34ms, but checks failed for an unrelated existing feature-gating issue: CLI-only test invocation compiles `main-cli.rs`, which references `readonly::embedding*` APIs gated behind `gui`. Need to narrow checks to relevant search/migration tests under the normal feature set so correctness backpressure matches the code under study.
